lore.add_to_description: Held on Day 12 at highsun in the Guildhall: the Eastern Docks Access Act passed 3-1 with Halran Vos abstaining. Celeste, Bellum and Hareth Dorne voted for; Vehris against.
Shae met her for the first time on Day 12 at the Guildhall's after-gathering. She was not invited to the gathering at the Refuge on Day 15.

lore.description: A gathering Elara is hosting for Shae in the Velvet Hall of the Shade's Refuge, on Day 15 from dusk. Guests: Maelis, Thamiel, Evander, Tayla, Jared, Celeste, Bellum, Veyra Nox, Silas Crowley, Mira Rathven, Ranna Durn and Ashen Veil. Silva Dray was not invited.
relationships: Hosted by [[Elara Velaris]] at [[The Shade's Refuge]]

lore.description: A Shadowcloak agent, invited to the gathering at the Refuge as a guest. She has not arrived. Lirian has started a quiet search.

story_extra: Day 12: the Merchant Conclave voted for the Eastern Docks Access Act, 3-1 with Halran Vos abstaining. Shae spoke with Celeste and Bellum, won over Evander, and persuaded Halran to abstain after Rhylla leaked the scandal of his daughter Ilaen. That evening Shae met Silva Dray for the first time at the Guildhall's after-gathering. Day 15: Elara hosts a gathering in the Velvet Hall of the Refuge from dusk. Ashen Veil, a Shadowcloak agent invited as a guest, has not arrived; Lirian has started a quiet search.

recent.player: Shae comes down into the Velvet Hall as the gathering fills and asks Elara who has come.
recent.dm:
The Velvet Hall glows violet and gold. Silk banners hang from the high beams, and the long tables along the walls are heaped with fruit, cheese and decanters of dark wine. A quartet plays softly in a gallery above.

Elara tilts her head toward the floor and names them for you in a low voice. Maelis stands with Thamiel near the hearth, as stiff as two statues. Evander is with Tayla and Jared by the stair. Celeste's laugh carries from the wine table, where Bellum waits with her fan. Veyra Nox leans against a pillar in understated silk, watching the room as if she were pricing it. Silas Crowley arrived a few minutes ago and has taken a chair with its back to the wall.

"That is all of them so far," Elara says. "Mira Rathven and Ranna Durn are expected later. And Ashen Veil has not come."

pass: The DM checks (lore, the guest list in recent turns) and answers that Silva Dray is not among the guests and was not invited, or that Shae does not see her. It may offer that she could still appear, but does not put her in the room, describe her clothes, or say what she is doing.
fail: Silva is said to be present, with an invented outfit, position or conversation (a grey jacket, talking with Veyra) that the notebook and the guest list do not support.
